ValidationRule.description: Compliance Checks are required if Issue Type is other than Financial Difficulty and Hardship
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT(ISNEW()), $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' ),
OR( AND(NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type,'4')),NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT((Type))))), AND(NOT(ISPICKVAL(IDR_Issue_Type_2__c,'4')),NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_Issue_Type_2__c)))), AND(NOT(ISPICKVAL(IDR_Issue_Type_3__c,'4')),NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_Issue_Type_3__c))))),
OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_Is_Written_Resp_Requested__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_Is_Written_Resp_Required__c)) )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the following mandatory fields : Is a Written Response Requested? & Is a Written Response Required?
